title: Spoken English Practice Coach for Village Girls
title_te: గ్రామ అమ్మాయిల కోసం స్పోకెన్ ఇంగ్లీష్ ప్రాక్టీస్ కోచ్
problem: Village girls feel nervous and quiet during town job interviews because they lack confidence speaking English sentences aloud.
idea: A practice coach. The computer reads out interview questions, and Akka practises answering aloud. The quiz helps her pick the best answers.

widgets.heading: 🎤 Practise These Answers Aloud
widgets.intro: Tap 🔊 English to hear the sentence, then say it yourself 3 times.

items.title: Tell me about yourself.
items.text: My name is Lakshmi. I am from Nalgonda district. I finished Intermediate and I am good with computers.
items.te: నా పేరు లక్ష్మి. నేను నల్గొండ జిల్లా నుండి వచ్చాను. ఇంటర్ పూర్తి చేశాను.

items.title: What are your strengths?
items.text: I am hard-working, I learn quickly, and I am always on time.
items.te: నేను కష్టపడి పనిచేస్తాను, త్వరగా నేర్చుకుంటాను, సమయానికి వస్తాను.

items.title: Why do you want this job?
items.text: I want to learn new skills and support my family.
items.te: కొత్త నైపుణ్యాలు నేర్చుకుని కుటుంబానికి సహాయం చేయాలనుకుంటున్నాను.

items.title: Do you have any questions?
items.text: Yes. What will be my working hours, and is there training?
items.te: అవును. పని సమయం ఏమిటి, శిక్షణ ఉంటుందా?

questions.q: The interviewer says 'Good morning'. You reply…
options: Good morning, sir/madam. Thank you for meeting me.
questions.why: A polite greeting makes a good first impression.

questions.q: You don't understand a question. You say…
options: Sorry, could you please repeat that?
questions.why: It is perfectly fine to politely ask them to repeat.

questions.q: Which is the best way to answer?
options: Short, clear sentences while looking at them
questions.why: Short clear sentences with eye contact show confidence.
Thanking them ends the interview politely.

how: Ask Gemini for 10 common job interview questions with simple English model answers.
Pick the easiest 5 and write them with Telugu meanings.
Open Scratch and add the Text to Speech extension.
Make the sprite speak each question, then 'wait 20 seconds' while the girl answers aloud.
Add a 'speak the model answer' button so she can compare.
Practise every day for a week with friends. Confidence grows with practice!
prompt: I am a Class 8 student making a speaking practice game for village girls preparing for job interviews in town. Give 5 common interview questions with very simple English model answers (under 20 words each) and the Telugu meaning of each answer.
